Vendor error mapping and explicit-platform PD contracts wrap the upstream handoff shape. ExitStack attempts all registered cleanup callbacks; engine shutdown remains in lifecycle finally. No new TP allowlist.

Prepare and freeze platform before endpoint registration; validation uses actual engine config; resource stack rolls back partial startup and transfers ownership only after success. Upstream structural-tag, video, token-budget and KV-hint metadata publication retained.
